about_the_game:
As an amateur racer with dreams of going pro, you find yourself in a tough spot when a risky bet goes horribly wrong. Down on your luck and stuck in a dead-end job you despise, your life takes a sudden turn when a beautiful woman rushes in, seeking your help. You decide to stand up to her pursuers.

Grateful for your help, she invites you to join her unorthodox crew of femme fatales, taking on specialized jobs for one of the most prominent crime families in the city. The promise of wealth and beautiful women is hard to resist, but you’ll have to decide whether to fall deeper into the criminal world or try to pull them out of it with you.

Lustful Heist is a harem-focused adult game full of player-choice, intense action, and intimacy with a vibrant cast of characters. Your decisions will shape your fate with each character, leading to multiple possible endings.

Will you fall deeper into a life of crime? What starts as a way to break the monotony of your life will force you to make tough choices. You’ll be presented with various options for handling conflict, whether through diplomacy or physical confrontation. You embody both sides of the coin: a lover and a fighter.

Content:

  • 11.300+ IMAGES

  • 280+ ANIMATIONS

Gameplay:

  • FULL VOICE-OVER (for all female characters)

  • Free Roam

  • Time Cycle

  • In-game Hint System

  • Define Your Own Relationships

  • Re-live HOT Scenes

  • "Lust Time" (interactive sex scenes)

  • And much more...
